claim_text_or_summary: In Madrid, meteorology yields a point-estimate predictability horizon gain of Delta H* = +8 h (H* = 17 h vs 9 h) over full-year 2023 evaluation.
required_evidence: Full-year rolling origin evaluation metrics by horizon
notes: Fully verified canonical result. Point estimate gain confirmed.

claim_text_or_summary: Evaluating Madrid over the common Jan-Jul 2023 window yields Delta H* = +10 h (H* = 19 h vs 9 h), but unbroken continuity from h=1 (H_from_h1) drops from 17 h to 0 h.
required_evidence: Jan-Jul 2023 common window rolling origin evaluation metrics
notes: Fully verified. Directionally stable, classified as POINT_ESTIMATE_POSITIVE.

claim_text_or_summary: Madrid block bootstrap Delta H* has a median of +3.0 h (95% CI [-8.0, +12.0] h) and P(Delta H* > 0) = 74.5%.
required_evidence: Block bootstrap resamples (B=2000, L=7 days, seed=20260802)
notes: Fully verified. Properly reflects sampling uncertainty alongside point estimate positivity.

claim_text_or_summary: Henry Street Limerick exhibits a point estimate gain of Delta H* = +7 h, but high bootstrap uncertainty (median +2.0 h, 95% CI [-10.0, +12.0] h, P(>0) = 69.9%).
required_evidence: Block bootstrap resamples (B=2000, L=7 days, seed=20260802) for Limerick

claim_text_or_summary: Five of eight Irish stations (Birr, Dundalk, Pearse St, Ringsend, Portlaoise) exhibit ceiling censoring (lags-only H* = 24 h).
required_evidence: Station-level H* summary table showing lags-only reaching max horizon h=24
notes: Fully verified. Highlights evaluation truncation ceiling artifact.

claim_text_or_summary: Madrid h=12 DM-HLN test is statistically significant under within-station FDR correction (p_fdr_station = 0.0493, p_raw = 0.0123), but does not survive global Bonferroni (p_bonf_global = 0.4314).
required_evidence: Diebold-Mariano test results with HAC lag correction and multiplicity adjustments across 35 valid tests
notes: Fully verified. Multiplicity control applied at station-level and global levels.

claim_text_or_summary: Dublin Airport h=24 (p_bonf_global = 0.0007) and Pearse Street h=12 (p_bonf_global = 0.0463) survive strict global Bonferroni correction across all 36 tests.
required_evidence: Global Bonferroni adjusted p-values from 35 valid DM-HLN tests
notes: Fully verified. Demonstrates robust statistical significance in key Irish locations.

claim_text_or_summary: Exact SARIMA predictions at h=24 recovered for Dublin Airport (H*_strict=24, H*_relax=24, skill=+0.0407) and Dundalk (H*_strict=18, H*_relax=24, skill=+0.1145).
required_evidence: SARIMA backtest predictions and metric completion table up to h=24
notes: Fully verified. Replaces former 23b lower-bound truncation with exact completed metrics.

claim_text_or_summary: Evaluating model sensitivity to post-COVID training window truncation (2022-only vs 2019-2022) was not performed due to local data availability constraints.
required_evidence: Experiment status document reporting E5 status as NOT_EXECUTED due to missing pre-2023 raw features
notes: Raw pre-2023 feature data not present locally. Correctly framed as a study limitation in manuscript.

claim_text_or_summary: Absolute MAE and RMSE metrics exist for all models, conditions, stations, and horizons (h=1..24).
required_evidence: CSV metrics tables containing absolute MAE, RMSE, MAE_persistence, RMSE_persistence, and n_eval
notes: Absolute metric values are present in exported CSVs but main manuscript tables focus on Skill score and H*.
